accounts.name: dead_shares_ata
docs: Dead-shares ATA — only required on the first deposit
(`total_supply == 0`). This is a usdOku ATA owned by the System
Program where `MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY` shares are permanently locked
to defeat the first-depositor inflation attack.
onto the context so Anchor enforces them declaratively (visible
in IDL, can't be silently bypassed by a future handler refactor).
The two remaining invariants — SP-owner + canonical-ATA — still
live in the handler because Anchor doesn't have a single
attribute that expresses "owner = system_program AND address ==
canonical ATA derivation for (mint, system_program, Token2022)".

instructions.name: wrap_to
docs: Wrap OkuMoney -> usdOku with a separate receiver.
Caller provides OkuMoney; receiver gets usdOku shares.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: MinimumLiquidity
errors.msg: First deposit must exceed minimum liquidity threshold

errors.name: InsufficientCollateral
errors.msg: Operation would breach minimum collateral ratio

errors.name: MissingDeadSharesAccount
errors.msg: Dead-shares ATA missing (required on first deposit)

errors.name: InvalidDeadSharesOwner
errors.msg: Dead-shares ATA owner must be the System Program

errors.name: InvalidDeadSharesAddress
errors.msg: Dead-shares ATA must be the canonical associated address

errors.name: UnexpectedDeadSharesAccount
errors.msg: dead_shares_ata must be omitted on subsequent deposits

errors.name: ZeroAuthority
errors.msg: Authority pubkey cannot be the zero pubkey

errors.name: YieldDistributionInProgress
errors.msg: Cannot perform operation in same slot as USD multiplier update

errors.name: OkuMoneyMintMismatch
errors.msg: Vault oku_money_mint must match PSM oku_money_mint

errors.name: InvalidOkuMoneyDecimals
errors.msg: OkuMoney mint must have exactly 6 decimals

errors.name: NoPendingRoleAdmin
errors.msg: No pending role-admin transfer to accept

errors.name: NotPendingRoleAdmin

types.name: AuthorityRole
docs: Authority roles that can be updated via set_authority.
These roles govern OkuDollar vault operations.

types.name: AuthorityUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when a vault authority role is updated. For two-step
`RoleAdmin` transfers this fires only on acceptance (not on proposal).

types.name: InitializeEvent
docs: Emitted when OkuDollar vault is initialized.

types.name: MinCollateralRatioUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when minimum collateral ratio is updated.

fields.name: unfreezer
docs: Cold Multisig - thaw accounts (requires deliberate review)

fields.name: oku_money_mint
docs: OkuMoney mint address (Token-2022 with InterestBearingConfig extension).
The extension is informational only — economic price comes from
`oku_m_price` on this account, not from the mint's interest accrual.

fields.name: vault_oku_money
docs: PSM's OkuMoney escrow vault for queued redemptions (ATA)
Holds OkuMoney while users are in queue (yield comes from price appreciation)

fields.name: minter_allowance
docs: Mint allowance remaining (configurable cap on freshly minted OkuMoney
between admin resets, mirroring the EVM `minterAllowance` pattern).

fields.name: last_yield_distribution_slot
docs: Solana slot of last yield distribution (sandwich prevention)
Operations like mint/redeem are blocked in the same slot as yield distribution

fields.name: pending_role_admin

types.name: ReservesDepositedEvent
docs: Emitted when reserves are deposited without minting shares.
EVM equivalent: `ReservesDeposited(address indexed depositor, uint256 okuMAmount, uint256 dollarValue, uint256 collateralizationRatio)`

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value of deposit at current oku_m_price

fields.name: collateralization_ratio
docs: Collateralization ratio after deposit (scaled by PRECISION, 1e9 = 100%)

types.name: ReservesWithdrawnEvent
docs: Emitted when surplus reserves are withdrawn.
EVM equivalent: `SurplusWithdrawn(address indexed to, uint256 okuMAmount, uint256 dollarValue, uint256 collateralizationRatio)`

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value of withdrawal at current oku_m_price

fields.name: collateralization_ratio
docs: Collateralization ratio after withdrawal (scaled by PRECISION, 1e9 = 100%)

types.name: RoleAdminTransferCancelledEvent
docs: Emitted when `cancel_role_admin_transfer` clears an in-flight proposal.

types.name: RoleAdminTransferProposedEvent
docs: transfer of the meta-role. Rotation is NOT yet effective — the new
admin must sign `accept_role_admin` to commit it.

types.name: UnwrapEvent
docs: Emitted when OkuDollar is unwrapped back to OkuMoney.
EVM equivalent: `Unwrapped(address indexed user, address indexed receiver, uint256 usdAmount, uint256 okuMReturned, uint256 okuMMultiplier, uint256 usdMultiplier)`

fields.name: receiver
docs: Receiver of the OkuMoney (may differ from user)

fields.name: usd_multiplier
docs: USD multiplier at time of unwrap (1e9 = $1.00)

fields.name: oku_m_price
docs: OkuMoney price at time of unwrap (1e9 = $1.00)

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value of the unwrapped amount
